name: Generalized LLM prompting library for Clojure

mentions.name: Generalized LLM prompting library for Clojure
mentions.description: A generalized LLM prompting library for Clojure, designed to be fun to use in an interactive way without too much abstraction. The accompanying notes cover tool loops, receipt extraction, and use with async flow.
mentions.problem: The author wanted LLM tooling that is fun to use in an interactive way, but not too abstracted.
mentions.source_excerpt: A generalized llm prompting library for clojure, and seeing what falls out from that. I wanted something which was fun to use in an interactive way, but not too abstracted.
